note: The read takes no selector. Unknown top-level member is rejected.
All four members are required — a partial status leaves a caller unable to tell an expired window from one that was never active.
`windowRemainingSeconds` must be a non-negative integer, not negative.
`windowRemainingSeconds` must be an integer, not a fraction of a second.

0.1's member name `windowRemainingSecs` is rejected: 0.2 renames it `windowRemainingSeconds`, which is required, so an otherwise-valid 0.1 response fails rather than being read as one with the window missing.
